{{Top|leg}}
The '''soldier beetle''' was a type of [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] that resided in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The design to the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], which was commonly used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], was based off of the soldier beetle.<ref name="OS&V 33">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 33|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 33]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The soldier beetle was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 33|thirthy-third issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection]]'', which was written by [[De Agostini]] and published in [[December]] of [[2009]].<ref name="Date">{{OSVCdates|33}}</ref>
